bass.tags: Hard rock featuring a prominent electric guitar riff using a wah-wah pedal and heavy distortion. The drums consist of a dry, punchy kick and snare with bright hi-hats. A distorted electric bass follows the guitar riff exactly. The tempo is 110 BPM in 4/4 time. The guitar uses a repetitive, syncopated blues-scale pattern with frequent pitch bends and vibrato. The production is dry with minimal reverb on the rhythm section.

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff centered on E. The drum kit features a dry, punchy snare and a double-kick pedal pattern that mirrors the guitar rhythm. A high-gain bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement consists of a repetitive, chugging rhythmic motif with frequent cymbal crashes on the downbeats. The guitar tone is characterized by high saturation and a mid-scooped EQ profile. The production is dry with minimal reverb on the percussion.
